description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of a git repository with sparse-checkout configurations. It includes setup for repositories, manipulation of sparse checkouts, and various commands that test the functionality of sparse checkout, sparse index, and related git features, often through scripted operations and assertions.

methods.name: init_repos
methods.description: Initializes three repositories in full, sparse-checkout, and sparse-index configurations with a common initial state and sparse-checkout definitions.

methods.name: init_repos_as_submodules
methods.description: Initializes repositories as submodules with associated configurations.

methods.name: run_on_sparse
methods.description: Runs a specified git command within the sparse-checkout or sparse-index repositories with specific input redirection.

methods.name: run_on_all
methods.description: Runs a specified git command across all repositories (full, sparse-checkout, sparse-index).

methods.name: test_all_match
methods.description: Runs a command and verifies that it produces the same output across all repositories.

methods.name: test_sparse_match
methods.description: Runs a command and verifies that the output matches in sparse checkout/index contexts.

methods.name: test_sparse_unstaged
methods.description: Checks that unstaged differences for a file are empty in sparse repositories.

methods.name: test_sparse_checkout_set
methods.description: Sets sparse checkout configurations and verifies the directory entries are correctly reflected in the sparse index.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running a provided command sequence.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files for equality in the test scenarios.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that the command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty, used to validate no unexpected output.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path is missing.

methods.name: test_path_exists
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path exists.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global git configuration for tests.

methods.name: test_region
methods.description: Measures and verifies performance regions in trace logs.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for text patterns in output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file for testing.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory.
